authority: User requests reassessment before making a decision; preserve prior measured improvement and compare gains/regressions fairly.
scope: Inference-only matched diagnostic across original foundation, short-answer child and broader candidate. No new checkpoint acceptance/rejection decision or training.
copy_factors: Four families x four fixed shared entities x known/novel values x familiar/novel wording; one turn. Same entities/facts cross wording. Known/novel values verified against actually consumed broader SFT stream.
history: Separate 16 three-turn actual conversations using known color/location values; initial answer, update, delayed recall scored separately. This is not a causal isolation of dialogue length from added distractors/corrections.
metrics: Complete normalized exact answer and EOS reported mechanically, primary semantic factual correctness judged separately with natural wording allowed; partial/full-format errors recorded. Clarification judged as a relevant grammatical question, not keyword presence alone. Paired model gains/losses and every stratum reported, no composite pass/fail threshold.
decoding: Full vocabulary greedy, max32 new tokens, stop BOS/EOS, native segmented chat format, actual generated previous answers retained.
limitations: Primary-authored/primary-judged, small correlated probes; novel wording one template per family. Known/novel values deliberately differ in training exposure and may differ in tokenization. Known labels reference the broader consumed stream, not equal original model exposure. No world-knowledge or new untrained quantity tasks included. No significance or causal model-ranking claim.
